name: Sabr Portal
summary: A tall terraced mosque entrance shelters an hourglass on its own foundation.
why: The entrance, hourglass waist, and lower plinth share x=57. The hourglass base joins the mosque foundation at y=76; its upper rim sits within the arch with ample space. A connected square minaret balances the stepped mass.
risk: The hourglass chamber simplifies at 24px, but its curved waist and solid sand-filled base remain. The monumental portal is intentionally more prominent than a dome.
key1: Time within a place of prayer
sub1: The hourglass rests on the mosque’s own foundation
sub2: One shared axis aligns the arch, waist, and plinth
theme: Time and patience within the mosque
reasonToChoose: You want a bold sculptural mosque with a distinctive balance of solid mass and generous openings.
